test_title: RRB ALP CBT-II (Mechanic Diesel) Official Paper (Held On: 06 May, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following instruments is used to insert a micrometer into the hole of the outer cylinder for zero alignment?
solution:
The correct answer is __Wrench**(Wrench)**.__

**__Key Points__**

__
 
• Wrench__ is a tool used for gripping and turning objects such as nuts and bolts.
 
• It provides leverage for applying torque to turn screws, bolts, or other mechanical components.
 
• Wrenches are typically made of metal and come in various sizes and shapes.
 
• They are essential in mechanical, automotive, and engineering tasks.
 
• Different types of wrenches include adjustable wrenches, pipe wrenches, and socket wrenches.
 
• They are vital for precision work and alignment in technical operations.

**__Additional Information__**

 
• **Allen Key:**

 
 
• Also known as a hex key, it is a small hand tool used to drive bolts and screws with hexagonal sockets.
 
• Commonly used in furniture assembly and machinery repairs.
 
 
 
• **Spanner:**
 
 
• Spanners are similar to wrenches but may refer specifically to tools used in British terminology.
 
• They are used for tightening or loosening fasteners.
 
 
 
• **Screw Driver:**
 
 
• A hand tool used to drive screws into materials.
 
• It comes in different types, such as flathead and Phillips-head screwdrivers.
